entities.name: PMID:25085452
observations: In 12 people with Parkinson disease, chronic subthalamic nucleus deep brain stimulation restored physiological rate-dependent attenuation of auditory P1/N1 responses, consistent with improved auditory sensory gating; acute stimulation on/off switching had no immediate effect. The study did not test P50 paired-click gating.

entities.name: Chronic STN-DBS improves auditory gating
observations: In 12 people with Parkinson disease, chronic STN-DBS restored rate-dependent attenuation of auditory P1/N1 responses; acute on/off switching had no immediate effect. This supports improvement in the measured gating paradigm, not P50 paired-click gating.
